title: ProBuild Membership Standing Code
content:
A Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership may be suspended, reviewed and reinstated, or closed, on the grounds set out in this code.

## Code

**§1 Suspension.** A membership is suspended for program misuse (purchases for resale under another business's number, sharing the member number) and, where the tier provides for suspension on a charge-off, when the member's Ridgeline Pro Credit account is charged off; while suspended no spend or points are credited and no points are redeemed. The membership records the suspension reason, program misuse or Ridgeline Pro Credit charge-off, and the date of suspension.

**§2 Review.** A suspended membership is reviewed the tier's review period, in months, after suspension, and either reinstated or closed. On reinstatement the membership is active again and the suspension reason is reset to none.

**§3 Closure by the member.** An owner or principal may close the membership at any time by their own confirmation.

**§4 Closure for inactivity.** The program closes a membership with no qualifying purchase for the tier's inactivity period, in months.

## Grounds and results

| Ground | Result |
|---|---|
| Purchases for resale under another business's number | suspension for program misuse |
| Sharing the member number | suspension for program misuse |
| Charge-off of the member's Ridgeline Pro Credit account, at a tier providing suspension on a charge-off | suspension |
| Review of a suspended membership | reinstated, or closed |
| An owner or principal's own confirmation | closure |
| No qualifying purchase for the inactivity period | closure by the program |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A membership suspended on 10 April at a tier whose review period is 6 months is reviewed on 10 October, and is then either reinstated or closed.
- During a suspension, a purchase under the member number credits no spend and no points, and the member cannot redeem points.
